architecture.active_lane: XGBoost supervised reranker (Stage 4) — tabular, fast, explainable
architecture.next_lane: PyTorch policy network (Stage 5) — agent action selector with SOM+CUDA
architecture.future_lane: QLoRA/RL (Stage 6) — after reward signals are stable
architecture.som_role: SOM 20×20 is topology routing stored in payload — NOT retrieval. EmbeddingGemma768→AE64→SOM→som_row/col/index. Policy (Stage 5) reads it.
architecture.xgboost_role: Stage 4: supervised ranking only — BM25, ANN, TurboVec, community_conf, concept_overlap, reward_prior, som_cache_hit (binary), provenance_git_age. som_cell_id (int) excluded — tree splits on SOM topology indices are meaningless.
